cohort: 639 participants from the Wayne County Health, Environment, Allergy and Asthma Longitudinal Study birth cohort
finding: Pets modified the CS-BMI relationship; children born via CS without a pet currently in the home had a statistically significant higher odds of being obese at age 2 years compared to children born vaginally without a pet.
mod_finding: Compared to children born vaginally without a pet currently in the home, children born via CS without a pet currently in the home had a statistically significant higher odds of being obese at age 2 years.
